text:
Maria: Heads-up: after merging #3312 (commit abc1f7d) into main we see p95 decode tail up on production routes. CI perf test failing. numbers: baseline p95=120ms -> 210ms on seq=512 workloads. Repro script attached.

Kevin: Confirmed on local: microbench shows ~45% slower token throughput with cache-heavy traces. Looks correlated with KV eviction spikes after the change to the fused-op scheduler.

Sasha: Which change in #3312? It changed batching heuristics + fusion window for attention kernels, right? Can you paste kernel-selector log?

Maria: attaching snippet:
```
kernel_selector: prefer=flash_attn_v2_fused
fallback=flash_attn_v1
selected=flash_attn_v1 (because heuristics flagged large prefix)
reason=eviction_pressure>0.2
```

Oliver: hmm eviction_pressure bumped from 0.05 to 0.27 in the run. KVCacheEvict logs:
```
KVCacheEvict: prefixes=12 freed=320KB t=0.3ms
cache_hit_rate: 0.12 -> 0.03
```

CI-Bot: perf/regressions/seq512 p95 210ms (threshold 140ms) -- test failed in job perf-decode-512 

Maria: Bisect started: narrowed to commit abc1f7d -> patch 3 in that PR. The change toggled `fusion_delay_ms` from 2 -> 12 and `batch_coalesce_window` from 8 -> 4.

Kevin: Quick test: forcing legacy kernel selection fixes it:
```
export RWD_KERNEL_FORCE=flash_attn_v2_fused
./bench_decode --model rwd-7b --seq 512 --batch 4 --iters 500
# p95 back to 118ms
```

Sasha: So heuristics are picking v1 because of eviction_pressure metric. But increasing fusion_delay increased parallelism that triggers eviction during continuous streaming. Maybe the fusion window increases concurrent KV buffers.

Oliver: Proposed fix: treat `eviction_pressure` as a soft signal and prefer fused kernel unless `cache_hit_rate < 0.06` and `eviction_count > 5` in last 1s. I can prototype change.

Maria: Can we gate the deployment? This is a rollout blocker. Suggest revert of the `fusion_delay_ms` change for release branch and land heuristic tweak in main.

DeployBot: rollback scheduled for release/main at 1880123600 if approved.

Kevin: +1 to revert, will open revert PR, include perf test that asserts p95 <= 140ms and cache_hit_rate > 0.08 on seq512 sim.

Sasha: I'll own the heuristic patch and a new unit test for kernel_selector using synthetic eviction traces.

Maria: Thanks — will coordinate rollback and postmortem after revert. :thumbsup:
